units.text: Nothing to go on yet from night 1 beyond player_1 dying to the sigil. I'd abstain today. Anyone who claims a night result, say who they went to and who came to them so we can line the claims up against the morning report.

Stay quiet on my role until a result is worth trading. Watch who claims night results and check them against the morning reports and each other. Player_3 has a night 1 visit on me, so track their claims closely. Lean toward abstaining on day 2 unless a concrete contradiction shows up.

Night 1 result: I followed player_3, who visited me. Player_1 was a chanteuse killed by a sigil, so the sigilist is alive and has one sigil left. Keep my trailseer role hidden for now. Follow players whose claims conflict or who attack at night, and check whether the morning report matches what I see. I have no vote lean yet and will pass until someone gives a concrete claim to test.

Night 1 I followed player_3, who visited me; that is a private lead to test, not yet a public claim. Keep my role hidden while the wolves can still target me, and hold the result for when it can be traded for a confirmed read. Build reads from the vote record and from morning reports, and cross-check any sighting against who was attacked or saved.

Night 1 follow on player_3 showed a visit to me, which is one data point and no verdict. Stay hidden for now and keep following the most suspicious player each night, checking the follow against the morning deaths and saves. Hold my result until it can be traded for something concrete, since revealing as trailseer marks me as a night target. Nothing in today's record gives a reason to vote yet.

Night 1 I followed player_3, and they visited me. Nobody has spoken yet, so there is nothing to test. Hold my result until someone makes a claim I can check against it. From night 2, follow the most suspicious player and compare their visits with the morning report, allowing for illusionist concealment. Do not reveal my role until a result is worth trading.

player_4, I did not go to your door on night 1, so the visit you describe cannot be real. A follow result naming me is false, and that's a fact I can stand on. Tell us your claimed role and exactly where your night 1 follow went, and why you think I'd be the one at your door.

player_4's trailseer story is false: no visit to player_4 happened on night 1, so their follow result cannot be right. I will not reveal my role yet. I'll press player_4 to name their role and night action, and I'll track the claims of player_5, player_6 and player_8 against each other.

player_4, your result is false. I know for a fact nobody came to your door on night 1, so there was no visit to read. Say what you think you saw and where the follow came from, or the lie is yours to carry.

Player_4's follow claim is false: no one came to their door on night 1, and I know that first-hand. I won't reveal my role yet. I'll press player_4 on the mismatch and test the power-role claims, starting with player_5's check and player_6's protection, and watch the vote record.

player_4, nobody visited you on night 1, so the visit you describe did not happen. Your result is either invented or belongs to a different night. Which night are you claiming, and what did you learn about me?

player_4's follow claim about me is false, so I will state that flatly and make them name the night and the result they say they saw. Keep my own role hidden for now. Use the watch left to test a power-role claim, most likely player_5 or player_6, to see which claims hold up. Vote on evidence about the claims, not on who talks most.

player_4, I won't say what I did at night, so I'm not going to call your follow false. My own watch never shows in my result, so a visit to your door could be real. Let's test the claims instead: player_8 says the sigil was theirs, and player_5 and player_6 each claim a role. Those three should be checked against each other before anyone votes.

My own watch on player_4 means I did visit them, and my result never shows my own visit, so player_4's follow claim is not disproven. I should not call it false. I will keep my role hidden for now and avoid pushing a false line. Test the power-role claims (player_5, player_6, player_8) against each other, and watch a claimed power role tonight.

player_4, I did not go to your door on night 1, and I can say flatly that nobody did. So your follow result cannot be right, whatever the wording. Either the result is invented or it names someone else. Explain where that line came from, and stop repeating the same sentence.

player_4's follow claim is false on my own result, so I will hold them to it and test the power-role claims (player_5, player_6) with my remaining watch. I stay hidden as Sentinel for now. Keep messages short and factual, and avoid piling onto the vote before the claims are checked.

Someone I saw went to player_7 on night 2, and that someone was player_10. player_7 says they checked player_10 on night 1 and it read clean, so player_7 should explain why player_10 went to them the next night. I would vote player_10 today on that visit.

I am the sentinel with no watches left, so my night-2 sighting is my only hard evidence. Player_10 visiting player_7 that night is the key lead; I will vote on it if no better lead appears. I will hold my role unless revealing it settles a lynch, and I will watch player_10 or player_7 only if I have a watch, which I do not.

player_10, you went to player_7 on night 2. What did you do there, and what came of it? player_7, your night-3 check on player_5 never got a chance to come back, so what did you learn from the other checks? I'd vote player_10 today until they answer.

I am the Sentinel with no watches left, so I can only read the table. Keep my role hidden unless a reveal settles a lynch. Test player_7's claim through the night-3 check and push player_10 for what they did on night 2. Vote on evidence, not on who talks most.

player_7, you planned a night-3 check on player_5 but haven't said what it read. Did you check them, and what came back? Player_5 is dead now, so that result is the one claim we can still weigh against the rest.

I am the Sentinel with no watches left, keeping my role hidden unless a reveal settles a lynch. Player_5 was the night-2 protector of player_7 and is now dead, so player_7's claimed night-3 check on player_5 is the only test left. I will watch whether player_7 reports a result, and I will not vote without a stated reason.

Player_7 says they checked player_10 and player_8 on nights 1 and 2, and that the save on player_7 matches the report. I'd vote player_10 today: they pushed hard on player_7's check nights, and I have a reason to think they visited player_7 on night 2, the same night the healer was there. Player_10, where did you go on night 2?

I am the Sentinel with no watches left, so I keep my night-2 sighting private unless it settles a lynch. Player_5 is the confirmed healer and its night-2 save on player_7 is consistent with the morning report. The wolf attacker on player_7 is likely player_10 or player_2, and player_10 is my current lynch lean. Test player_7's check claims against the next night's results.

Looking at night 2: my watch on player_7 saw player_2, player_5 and player_10 come to them, and player_2 was a wolf, so one of the two remaining visitors was the attacker. I'd vote player_10 today. Player_7, what did your night-3 check on player_5 show?

I am the Sentinel with no watches left, so I keep my role hidden unless revealing it settles a lynch. My night-2 watch on player_7 showed player_2, player_5 and player_10 visiting, and player_5's healer claim is confirmed. Player_7's night-3 check on player_5 is the test to watch, and player_10 is the main suspect from that night.

player_7, you said you'd check player_5 tonight, and I'm watching that. player_8, you say player_7 checked you on night 1, but player_7 says night 1 was player_10. Which is it? Let's see tomorrow's result before anyone votes on a claim.

I am the hidden trailseer. My night-2 follow confirmed player_7 visited player_8, consistent with a check claim but not proof. I will follow player_7 tonight to test whether the announced check on player_5 happens. Player_8 remains the key contradiction point. Keep my results private unless a fake-investigator push needs them.

player_7 said last night they would check player_5, but they went nowhere that night, so that check did not happen. Their night-2 check on player_8 and the night-3 plan don't line up with that. I'd vote player_7 unless someone can show why their check claims hold.

I am the hidden trailseer. My night-2 follow confirmed player_7 visited player_8, but on night 3 player_7 visited no one despite the announced plan to check player_5, so the investigator claim is weakening. Test player_7's check claims against the morning reports and track whether player_8 backs or contradicts them. Reveal my follow results only if a fake-investigator push needs them.

player_7, you said last day you'd check player_5 on night 3, but player_5 was killed by the wolves and no check result came out. Did you actually use that check, and on who? Answer that before anyone votes on player_8 or player_9.

I am the hidden trailseer. Player_7's night-2 check on player_8 fits what I saw, but their planned night-3 check on player_5 did not happen, so player_7 looks like a fake investigator or a wolf. Keep my follow results private for now and press player_7 on the missed check. Player_8 and player_9 need more evidence before I vote.

Player_7 said they checked player_5 last night, but I followed player_7 and they visited no one. Either the check didn't happen or player_7 is not telling the table the truth about night 3. player_7, which was it?

I am the hidden trailseer. My night-2 follow saw player_7 visit player_8, which fits player_7's check claim but does not prove it. My night-3 follow saw player_7 visit no one, so the claimed check on player_5 did not show. Keep results private unless a fake-investigator push needs them. Test player_7's claims against the next night's follows and the morning report.

player_7, you said you planned a check on player_5 last night, but I followed you and you visited no one. Did the check happen? If you didn't check, your claimed night 3 result is not real and player_8's night 1 account stands. Name who you checked and what you read.

I am the hidden trailseer. My night 3 follow showed player_7 visiting no one, so player_7's claimed check on player_5 did not happen as a visit I could see. Player_7 is the investigator claim to test; player_8 is the one contradicting them. I will keep my results private unless a fake-investigator push needs them.
Night 4 I followed player_1 and saw them go to player_3, who the wolves killed that night. player_1, what did you do there? Until you answer, you are my vote if one were held now.

I am the trailseer and already claimed it publicly, so I can share my follows. Night 4 I followed player_1, who visited player_3. I will press player_1 for what they did there and keep testing untested players with follows, sharing only what I saw.

I'll say it now: I'm the trailseer. Last night I followed player_1 and they went to player_3, who the wolves killed. That's my only hard visit from that night. player_1, what did you go to player_3 for?

I am the trailseer and my follows are night 1 player_9 (no visits), night 2 player_7 (visited player_8), night 3 player_7 (no visits), night 4 player_1 (visited player_3). player_3's sentinel report matches my night-2 follow, so I treat it as likely genuine. The wolves left are the chanteuse and possibly the necromancer, so I should test player_1 and player_6 next. I'll share my follow results plainly and watch how player_1 explains the night-4 visit.

Night 4 I followed player_1, and they went to player_3. I'm not sure what that visit was, so player_1, what did you do there? player_6 and player_8, I'd like to hear your night 4 story too, since the only thing I can confirm is that visit.

I am the trailseer. My follows: night 1 player_9 (no visits), night 2 player_7 (visited player_8), night 3 player_7 (no visits), night 4 player_1 (visited player_3). player_7's night-3 check claim was false per my follow. I'll test player_1 next and share only what I saw.

I'm player_10. Last night I followed player_1, and they went to player_3, who was killed by the wolves. I'll share my follows: player_9 visited no one on night 1, player_7 went to player_8 on night 2 and visited no one on night 3. player_1, why did you go to player_3 last night?

I am the trailseer and my follows are night 1 player_9 (no visits), night 2 player_7 (visited player_8), night 3 player_7 (no visits), night 4 player_1 (visited player_3). player_7's night-3 check claim was false per my follow, and player_3's sentinel report matches my visit. I will share only what I saw and prefer to follow untested players like player_6 or player_8 next to test the wolf pair.

I'm the trailseer. Last night I followed player_1, and they went to player_3, who was then killed by the wolves. The only wolf left is the chanteuse, so I'd vote player_1 today unless someone can explain that visit.

I am the trailseer. My follows: night 1 player_9 (no visits), night 2 player_7 (visited player_8), night 3 player_7 (no visits), night 4 player_1 (visited player_3, who was then killed by the wolves). Player_1 is my top suspect as the Chanteuse. I will vote player_1 unless new evidence clears them, and I will keep reporting what I actually saw.

I'm the trailseer. My follows: night 4 player_1 went to player_3, night 5 player_6 visited no one. player_6, you haven't claimed anything, so what did you do on nights 4 and 5? I'd vote player_6 today unless they give a checkable claim.

Both wolves are dead, so the one threat left is the Necromancer, which is player_6 or player_8. I am the Trailseer and I have shared my follows: night 4 on player_1 (went to player_3) and night 5 on player_6 (visited no one). Vote the player with no verifiable role first, and keep checking any sigil or check claim against follow results.

Both wolves are dead, so the Necromancer is one of player_6 and player_8. My night 5 follow of player_6 showed no visits, so I have no evidence on them yet. player_8, your sigilist claim names no target on nights 1 to 4, while my follows show player_7 going to you on night 2, which fits a check rather than a sigil. Who wants to explain why they claim a sigil but never used one?

I am the only verified town survivor besides player_8. The Necromancer is one of player_6 and player_8, and both wolves are dead. Keep following the unclaimed player each night and compare player_8's sigilist account with my follow records.

My follows: night 2 player_7 went to player_8, night 4 player_1 went to player_3, night 5 player_6 visited no one. player_8, you say you placed no sigil, so player_1's door visit on player_3 is unexplained by you. player_6, you have made no claim, so tell us what you did on night 5 or why you held.

Only player_6 and player_8 remain unresolved besides me, and one of them is the Necromancer. My night 5 follow of player_6 showed no visit, which is consistent with a Necromancer staying put, so I will keep following the unclaimed one and compare future follow results against any claimed kills through reanimated bodies. Share my follow results when asked.

I'm the trailseer. I followed player_6 last night and they visited no one. player_6 hasn't claimed a role, so unless they explain their night, I'd vote player_6 today. player_8's sigil claim is still unchecked by my follows.

Both wolves are dead, so the Necromancer is one of player_6 or player_8. Following player_6 on night 5 showed no visits. Vote on the unclaimed player unless the follow evidence changes, and keep checking player_8's sigil claim against the follows.

I'm the trailseer. Night 5 I followed player_6 and they visited no one. Night 4 I followed player_1 and they went to player_3, which fits player_1's sigil claim. player_6 hasn't claimed anything, so I'd vote player_6 unless they explain where they went or what they did.

Both wolves are dead, so the Necromancer is player_6 or player_8. Test player_6 with the follow results I hold and keep tracking player_8's sigil account against them. Share my follow results openly now, since they can help the town vote.

I'm the trailseer. Night 1 I followed player_6 and they went to player_7. The record says player_6 was our sentinel, so player_7 is worth a look, and player_7 should say who came to them. Nothing else to go on yet, so I'm not voting anyone today.

I am the trailseer and I have now chosen to claim it softly, since the night 1 follow on player_6 gave a useful visit to player_7. Watch for who answers the player_7 question and whether any sentinel or investigator claim conflicts with my trail. Do not vote blindly on day 2; push for concrete tests and track the voting record.

Night 1 follow on player_6 showed a visit to player_7, which may be a sentinel watch and is not yet proof of anything. Nothing is verified about any player yet, so I will hold my role and result until a claim or contradiction makes sharing worth it. I will track claims and any night results that conflict with the follow data. If a result becomes important, I may soft-claim early next day.
I'm trailseer, and I'll say it since the trail matters. I followed player_6 last night and they visited player_7. Player_7, do you have anything to say about that visit?

I followed player_6 on night 1 and saw them visit player_7. Player_6 was a sentinel who died that night, so that visit may be a watch. I am now willing to claim trailseer to share the trail. Next I will watch how player_7 handles the claim and whether anyone pushes back on it.

I'm trailseer. Last night I followed player_6, who is dead now, and they went to player_7. Could be a watch or nothing, but player_7, what did you do on night 1? Anyone who has a result from last night, post it so we can line up the claims.

I followed player_6 on night 1 and saw a visit to player_7. Treat that as the one concrete lead and test player_7 with questions. Revealing trailseer early was a deliberate risk, so keep the claim short and watch whether the wolves react. Next night, consider following whoever is most accused.

I'll say it since the floor's open: I'm the trailseer. Night 1 I followed player_6, and they went to player_7. player_6 is dead now, so player_7 should say what they know about that visit before we decide who to trust.

I followed player_6 on night 1 and they visited player_7, a concrete lead since player_6 was a sentinel who was stabbed. I am now going public as trailseer to put that visit on the table while it is fresh. Expect a possible night target, so keep future follow results shared early. Watch player_7's response and whether anyone claims to have been visited by or to have visited player_6.

I'm the trailseer. Night 1 I followed player_6, who went to player_7. Night 2 I followed player_9, who went to player_4. player_9, you claimed investigator: who did you check last night, and what did you get?

I am the public trailseer and need to make the claim count. Follow player_9 to test their investigator claim: a real check is a visit, and their night-2 visit went to player_4, who is now dead. Keep the trailseer result for when it helps most, and treat player_1's doubt as something to answer, not ignore.

Trailseer here, so I'm on the record. Last night I followed player_9 and they went to player_4. If player_9 is the investigator, that check on a wolf would read Suspicious, so I'd like player_9 to say what they got. I'm not voting anyone yet.

Player_2 flipped Speculator, so the day 2 lynch was a miss. Player_9 claimed investigator, and my follow on them last night went to player_4, who was a wolf, which fits a check on player_4. Next I want player_9's claim tested against their next night, and I'll keep watching the Illusionist and Serial Killer among player_1, player_5, player_7 and player_8.

I'm the trailseer. Night 1 I followed player_6, who went to player_7. Night 2 I followed player_9, who went to player_4. player_9 claimed investigator, so a check on player_4 would have come back Suspicious. Living players, who did you check or follow last night?

Player_9 is dead, so my night-2 follow can no longer be repeated. Test the investigator claim through what the dead player did: on night 2 they visited player_4, the chanteuse, so a check on player_4 would have read Suspicious. Keep my trailseer role public and ask the living players for their night visits. Vote only with a stated reason.

Night 2 I followed player_9 and they went to player_4. Player_4 was then struck by a sigil, so that visit fits a sigilist placing a sigil better than an investigator check on them. I have no vote lean yet, so I want to hear from player_1, player_5, player_7 and player_8 first.

Night 2 I followed player_9 and they went to player_4, who was then struck by a sigil, which fits a sigilist placing a sigil better than an investigator check. Player_9's investigator claim is now doubtful. Watch whether any living player claims a sigil or check on player_4 and how that squares with my follow. Keep my trailseer claim public and test the living players' claims against each other.

Since I claimed trailseer on the record: night 1 I followed player_6 and they visited player_7. Night 2 I followed player_9 and they visited player_4, who was the chanteuse. That fits player_9 checking player_4, so their investigator claim has some support. Nothing else gives me a reason to vote yet.

Trail results so far: night 1 player_6 visited player_7; night 2 player_9 visited player_4, the dead chanteuse. Player_9's claimed check on player_2 is void, but a visit to player_4 fits an investigator check. Keep following the claimed investigator's visits to test whether they act at night. Share the trail results openly so the table can weigh them, and vote only on evidence.

Yes, I was at your door last night, player_4, and nothing came to me that I know of. I'll keep the why to myself for now. Player_6 and player_8 both made claims, so let's see who backs them up before we vote on anyone.

Night 1 watch on player_4 was empty, so no one visited them. player_4's follow claim would show my visit, which is true. Hold my role for now. Track the night 2 kill pattern and whether player_8's sigil claim holds.
Yes, player_4, I went to your door. I'm the sentinel, and my watch that night showed nobody else visiting you, so your follow result lines up with mine. I'll hold my last watch for a useful target.

Player_1 was a wolf killed night 1 by the Sigilist, so one wolf and the Necromancer remain. Player_4's follow claim is consistent with my watch, which showed no other visitors. Test the healer and investigator claims against the night results, and watch the most-accused player.

Yes, I was at your door last night, player_4, and nothing came to you that night. I'm not going to say more about my night yet. Let's see who makes checkable claims today so we can test them against each other.

Player_1 was a wolf (chanteuse) killed by player_8's sigil, so one wolf and the Illusionist remain plus the Necromancer. My night 1 watch on player_4 was empty, which is weak news. I visited player_4 and will admit it without giving my role. Test the claims: player_4 and player_6 should be checked against the next night's results.

player_4, yes, I was the one at your door last night, but I was watching you, so I'm not the visitor you saw. My watch showed nobody else came to you, which is a fact you can check against your follow. Let's see who else's night lines up with that.

Player_1 was a wolf (chanteuse) killed by my ally's sigil, so the sigilist is town-aligned and has one sigil left. My watch on player_4 saw no visitors. The necromancer may start killing from night 2, so I'm holding my last watch for a likely victim or a conflicting claim. Stay open about my role until it's worth revealing.

player_4, I did not follow anyone and I did not visit you last night. Whoever you think visited you, it wasn't me, so your claim doesn't fit. Who do you think followed you, and what else did you learn?

I am the Sentinel with one watch left. Player_1 was a wolf who was killed by a sigil on night 1. Player_4 claims I followed them and visited them, but my own night 1 watch on player_4 saw no visitors, so I should challenge that claim. Keep my role hidden for now and watch the Necromancer's likely victims from night 2.

I am the necromancer and have no night result to offer. Stay quiet while the claims settle, then pick a cover that fits the record when results are expected. From night 2, prefer info-gathering through a dead body over kills, since kills read Suspicious.

player_4, you and player_3 cannot both be right about a follow, so the next thing to check is whether anyone else saw a visit at player_3's door. Until someone adds a result, I'd treat the follow claim and the denial as equally unproven.

Night 1 I did nothing, so I have no result to offer. Stay low and let claims come out first. Choose a safe cover only when the town starts asking for results. From night 2, prefer info-gathering through a dead body over kills.

Night 1 I did nothing, so I have no result to offer and should not claim yet. Stay quiet unless addressed. Once town expects results, choose the safest cover, such as Speculator or Sentinel, and keep the story unchanged. From night 2, use a dead body for information rather than kills, since kills read Suspicious.

Night 1 I did nothing by rule, so I have no result to offer. Stay unclaimed while others make claims, and do not speak without a new point. From night 2, prefer information through a dead body over kills, since kills read Suspicious and paint a target. Once the town starts expecting results, pick the safest cover that fits my nights.

Worth noting: player_6's night 1 protection on player_10 and player_8's sigil on player_1 both fit the record, but nothing tests either yet. If player_6 protects again tonight, and player_8 keeps one sigil, the next attack or sigil result will show who is telling the truth.

Night 1 I did nothing by rule, so I have no result to offer. Keep a low profile and do not claim yet. Let the claims of player_5, player_6 and player_8 be tested against night results before choosing a cover. From night 2, prefer info-gathering through a dead body over kills.

player_4, your claim is the problem: a follow shows where the followed player went, so your result should read as player_3 going to someone, not as a visit to your door. Quote the exact text and say whether it named a destination. player_6, if you protected player_10 on night 1, nobody attacked them, so that save proves nothing either way.

Chanteuse died night 1 to a sigil, so the Sigilist's claim checks out. Town has more roles still alive than the wolves, so I lean Town. I have no night result and no pick yet. Test the player_3/player_4 follow claim and the Healer claim before I pick, and aim to pick by end of night 2.

player_4, a follow shows where the followed player went, so your result would be 'player_3 visited player_4'. Which night did you follow player_3, and did you have any other visit that night? player_3 says they never went to you. One of your results must be misread, and that is checkable.

Town has the sigil result and player_8's sigilist claim matches the record, so Town is ahead for now. Player_4 and player_3 contradict each other on what the follow showed; I want their exact night-1 visits pinned down. I have no night result and no side yet, so I stay neutral and keep listening. I'll pick Town by the end of night 2 unless the town roles drop quickly.

The record backs player_8's sigil claim, since player_1 died to a sigil with no save. Player_5 and player_6 are both making role claims, so I'd like to know if player_5's check on player_8 means player_8 is cleared, and whether player_6 protected anyone who was actually attacked on night 2.

Town is ahead on numbers after player_1's death, but wolves still have illusionist and necromancer. Test claims: player_5's not-suspicious check and player_6's protection. Pick Town by end of night 2 unless town roles drop. No night result of my own yet.

The record says player_1 carried the kill on night 1, so player_8's sigil claim fits. player_5, your check on player_8 is worth tracking if player_8 is a real sigilist. player_4, if you followed player_3, you would only see where player_3 went, so your 'player_3 visited me' line is the thing to explain.
Sigilist and healer claims are both town-aligned and checkable against the record. Watch player_4 and player_3 for the follow/watch mismatch. Pick Town by end of night 2 unless town roles fall fast.

Night 1 killed the Chanteuse by sigil, so the wolf pack is down to the illusionist. Stay quiet and collect reads until the first vote gives a record. Pick Town by end of night 2 unless town roles fall fast.

player_10, I did nothing on night 1, and calling me quiet is not evidence. I'm claiming Speculator and have made no visits. You're pushing a vote on the sigil death, but player_8 has claimed that sigil, so that's theirs to answer for. I'd rather see who backs the player_3/player_4 story first.

Night 1 done nothing, claim Speculator with no visits to keep cover. Keep a low profile and answer direct accusations briefly. Watch the player_3/player_4 dispute and track who backs the lynch push. From night 2, consider a dead-body check through player_1's Chanteuse role.

player_10, you're pinning a Necromancer read on me from one sigil death, but a sigil on a wolf is exactly what happened to player_1, so the night-one death doesn't single anyone out. I'd rather see player_8 and player_5 face a direct check on each other's claims before anyone votes.

Night 1 done nothing. Stay unclaimed for now and keep a low profile; avoid being the one pushed. Watch the player_3/player_4 clash and the sigil claim by player_8. From night 2, consider a dead-body check or follow through player_1's Chanteuse body, which reads Not suspicious.

player_10, I did nothing on night 1, so I have no result to give anyone and I'm not claiming a role yet. The sigil-struck death doesn't point at me; I'd rather see who backs up their night claims before we vote anyone. What do you base the push on besides the kill?

Night 1 I did nothing, so I have no result to give and stay unclaimed. Keep a low profile and avoid voting out a player on thin evidence. Watch the player_3 vs player_4 follow dispute and the claims of player_5, player_6 and player_8 as they settle. Consider a dead-body check from night 2 only if it reads Not suspicious.
